title.zh: AI21 Jamba 1.7 家族发布公告

summary.zh: 官方日志 July 3, 2025 段落公告 Jamba 1.7，并直接链接 Large 1.7 与 Mini 1.7；这是一个家族公告事件，不是两次权重发布。公告时刻与时区未登记。
summary.en: The official July 3, 2025 changelog announces Jamba 1.7 and links Large 1.7 and Mini 1.7. This is one family-announcement event, not two weights releases; time and timezone are unrecorded.

note.zh: 不是权重首次公开日期，也不证明精确 API 版本。两个成员的首次完整公开权重日期、固定修订和历史许可证适用性仍未知；公开卡链接自定义许可，不据此称为完整开源或无限制商用。成员链接只标明公告所指对象，不证明当前下载资格。未接受访问协议、下载权重或运行模型。
note.en: Not a first-public weights date or proof of an exact API revision. First complete public weights dates, pinned revisions and historical license applicability remain unknown for both members. Cards link a custom license, not proof of fully open-source AI or unrestricted commercial use. Member links identify announcement targets, not current download eligibility. No access agreement accepted, weights downloaded or model run.
